label: Retention period
type: the period after which a backup becomes eligible for deletion via backup:pruning. Scoped three ways per this round's evidence: set at repository-CREATION time, EDITED later at repository level, or overridden for an INDIVIDUAL backup within the repository - each with its own URI and a `retroactive` flag controlling whether a repository-level change reaches backups that already exist. None of this three-way scoping is described on backup-service.md, which only ever says the period is 'specified in the plan' - the REST reference (backup-retention.md) is materially more detailed than the conceptual overview page for this specific mechanism.
evidence: The Backup Service retains backups for a period of time you specify in the plan using the retention period.
Configure the Backup Service to retain backups in a repository by setting a retention period.
You can set a retention period for a repository when creating it or editing it later. After creating a repository, you can set a custom retention period for individual backups.
